<function name="GetWalkSpeed" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Returns the player's normal walking speed. Not sprinting, not slow walking. (+walk)

See also <page>Player:SetWalkSpeed</page>, <page>Player:GetMaxSpeed</page> and <page>Player:GetRunSpeed</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The normal walking speed.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Gets player 1's walk speed, and prints it to console</description>
	<code>print( Entity( 1 ):GetWalkSpeed() )</code>
	<output>200 in console by default</output>

</example>
